name: CTCI Corporation
summary: CTCI Corporation provides engineering, procurement, and construction services in Taiwan, rest of Asia, and the United States. The company offers project management; feasibility study and front-end engineering design; engineering; procurement; fabrication; construction; commissioning; automation and control; cleanroom, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing; intelligent structure jacking and movement; ground freezing; and operations and maintenance services, as well as intelligent solutions. It also provides stationary equipment, chemical additives, and energy management software.
